notes.title: Updates and Plans for 2024
notes.content:
Hello there,

We're thrilled to share the latest developments and exciting plans for our game in 2024! The journey of developing Wind Runners has been an exhilarating adventure, and we're eager to provide you with an exclusive glimpse into the heart of the game.

[h2][b]Core Systems and Foundation:[/b][/h2]
All major systems and foundational elements of Wind Runners are now complete and fully operational.

[previewyoutube=NJCloqWjOxY;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=yW1WpyNHDo8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Capital Ship:[/b][/h2]
This is where you can purchase your permanent upgrades and visit the codex to learn more about the game's lore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35534335/d5dd699f8752363ae22dfef053ee9c4b9dab5ec7.png[/img]

[h2][b]The Saints and the Cardinal Beasts:[/b][/h2]
We're working hard to make the boss fights epic, and so far, we're quite pleased with the results we've achieved, both in art and gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35534335/f894bf4af86808a00b923d1f0585b36d13b26e89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35534335/813af66146938a51b63ac1fe1419cc41936233ed.png[/img]
All enemies in the game are 3D, this is just a sketch to illustrate the proportions of these colossal enemies known as Cardinal Beasts

[h2][b]Discord Community Launch:[/b][/h2]
We are launching the Ludic Discord for those interested in closely following the game's development, learning more about the demo, sharing feedback, or contributing ideas.

[url=https://discord.gg/2THD8Sh8De]Check out our Discord!![/url]

Thank you all for your support, and Happy New Year!

notes.title: About Wind Runners
notes.content:
[h1]Wind Runners: [/h1]

For centuries, the Realm uses fear and its military superiority to keep the Zarah Igna System under control, but a group of rebellious Ishma arises to fight its tyranny. With their superior aerial combat skills, the Wind Runners will bring freedom to all who live under the shadow of oppression!

Wind Runners is rogue like side scroller dogfight game. Choose one of the available ships, each one with unique weapons, evolve its power with equipment and improvements acquired along the game and go fight against "The Torments", giant metal beasts, scattered throughout the planets of Zarah Igna system.

[h2]Current State of the game: [/h2]
[b]This build contains:[/b]
[list]
[*] 5 planets.
[*] 40 items.
[*] 3 playable characters.
[*] Suport for gamepad ps4, xbox controller
[*] Colorblind Mode
[/list]

[b]The final version will have:[/b]
[list]
[*] 13 planets and a system to navigate between them.
[*] Usable items.
[*] 7 playable characters.
[*] Unique special ability to the playable characters.
[*] Quests to unlock items and characters.
[*] Narrative and story content.
[*] More enemies.
[*] 13 bosses.
[*] Enhanced score system.
[*] Local and global leaderboard.
[/list]

[h3]Meet the Team:[/h3]
Hi everyone, we are a small indie game studio located in Brazil called Ludic Studios:


[b]Joel Hamon:[/b] Producer, PR and Programmer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35534335/ba63277ee2cdd850d6ffb0e3ae855147a621e484.png[/img]


[b]Artur Fernandes: [/b]Artist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35534335/d7e75a31f23569ea7e6de5273bbc54f07dc513ae.png[/img]


[b]Lui Gama:[/b] Game Designer and Programmer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35534335/9decbe9976be4b5a4ac50226943bae435bedd776.png[/img]

The game has a medieval futuristic style.
The initial idea to create the game was inspired on real story about the Night Witches, a group of Russian pilots who became very famous in WW2 for bombing German bases at midnight.
Then we went looking for more references for the game in animes and movies like: Macross, Gurren Lagann, Cowboy Bebop, Neon Genesis Evangelion and Star Wars.
Other references was games like Risk of Rain, Luftrausers, Dead Cells.

We hope that everyone like our new game and feel free to contribute with your thoughts
